mapper.insert: insert or ignore into article_favorites (article_id, user_id) values (#{favorite.articleId}, #{favorite.userId})
mapper.delete: delete from article_favorites where article_id = #{favorite.articleId} and user_id = #{favorite.userId}
mapper.select: select AF.article_id favoriteArticleId, AF.user_id favoriteUserId from article_favorites AF where AF.article_id = #{articleId} and AF.user_id = #{userId}
